## Checklist
- [ ] Code follows Clean Architecture — no cross-layer leaks
- [ ] Unit tests added / updated for new business logic
- [ ] All existing tests pass (`./gradlew test`)
- [ ] Detekt passes with no new warnings (`./gradlew detekt`)
- [ ] No hardcoded strings, keys, or secrets
- [ ] Documentation updated if behaviour changed
- [ ] PR targets the correct branch (`dev` for features, `master` only from `staging`/`hotfix`)
